description: This source file contains unit tests for the discovery capabilities handler in a Go web service, specifically testing various scenarios like default responses, filter handling, format variations, and cache validation. It uses the Gin framework for HTTP routing, testify for assertions, and includes stub implementations for agent listing.

methods.name: TestDiscoveryCapabilities_Defaults
methods.description: Tests the default response of the discovery capabilities endpoint, ensuring correct totals and structure.

methods.name: TestDiscoveryCapabilities_WithFiltersAndSchemas
methods.description: Tests the endpoint with various filters and schema inclusion flags, verifying filtered results and schema presence.

methods.name: TestDiscoveryCapabilities_Formats
methods.description: Tests different output formats (XML and compact JSON) and skill filtering, verifying correct serialization.

methods.name: TestDiscoveryCapabilities_ValidationAndCaching
methods.description: Validates parameter input error handling and caching behavior, ensuring repeated calls reuse cache.
